d: Tejashwi Yadav on Ashok Choudhary : jediyu kote se mantri ashok chaudhri vivadon men hain... ashok chaudhri par ek sath tin pad aur 'labh ke pad' ka aarop hai... is bich ab neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne ghera hai... guruvar ko tejasvi yadav ne eks par post karte hue kaha ki ve is pure mamle ko oopar tak le jaenge...tejasvi yadav ne kaha ki bihar sarkar ne sanvidhan ko phar kar kure ke dher men phenk diya hai... 9 mahinon se ek pharji mantri ko sarkar men baitha rakha hai aur vah avaidh mantri har prakar ke avaidhanik karyon men sanlipt hai... lokabhvan ne ek hi vyakti ke ek sath tin…
